meta.name: oh-my-issues
meta.description: Cluster a GitHub issue backlog by root cause into a small set of plan-master issues, redirect children with a standardized comment, and bundle architectural-fix PRs that close clusters atomically. Use when an issue tracker has accumulated dozens of reports that share underlying defects, when asked to triage / consolidate / cluster / dedupe issues, when asked to build a plan series or roadmap from open issues, or when routing a new incoming bug into an existing plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub issue 按根因聚类为计划，自动重定向子问题并打包修复 PR
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 issue 列表里堆满了重复报告，想按根因统一治理
copy.tagline_en: Cluster GitHub issues by root cause into plans, redirect children, and bundle fix PRs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your issue tracker is cluttered with duplicate reports and you want to consolidate by root cause

howto.what: Claude 会把 GitHub 上堆积的 issue 按根因归成几组，每组建一个 plan-master 总 issue 和 plans/0X-*.md 设计文档，用统一评论重定向并关闭子 issue，再让一个 PR 原子关闭整组。
howto.when: 当仓库累积 20+ 未关 issue 且多为同一缺陷的不同表现，或你要求聚类去重、从 issue 列表做路线图，或要判断新报的 bug 属于哪一组时触发。

say.text: 把这批 issue 按根本原因聚类，生成 plan-master 列表
这个新 bug 属于哪个已有的 plan？
say.note: 匹配上就加一条 Round N 评论并把它关掉

say.text: 把 plan-02 的所有子 issue 打包成一个 PR 关掉
say.note: PR 描述用 Closes #N 自动关闭子 issue

howto.what_en: Claude clusters a GitHub issue backlog by root cause, opens one plan-master issue plus a plans/0X-*.md doc per cluster, closes children with a standard redirect comment, and ships one PR per cluster that closes children atomically.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a repo has 20+ open issues that look like the same defect, when you ask to triage, cluster, or dedupe issues into a roadmap, or route a new bug into an existing plan.

say_en.text: Cluster these issues by root cause and open plan-master issues
say_en.note: Reads bodies and comments first, then opens masters

say_en.text: Which existing plan does this new bug belong to?
say_en.note: Adds a Round N comment and closes the child

say_en.text: Bundle plan-02's children into one PR that closes them
say_en.note: PR body uses Closes #N to auto-close children
